text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a non-review research paper focused primarily on land use land cover (LULC) future prediction and simulation for China at the national scale. The study explicitly implements scenario-based LULC projections under multiple SSP-RCP scenarios (SSP245, SSP370, SSP585) with quantitative comparison. It uses a spatially explicit modeling framework (LUH2-PLUS-InVEST) that downscales global LUH2 data to 500 m resolution for China, with accuracy metrics reported (overall accuracy >90%, Kappa ~0.9). The paper provides mapped LULC projections and simulates LULC spatial patterns and carbon storage changes from 2025 to 2050. The methodology and results confirm national-scale spatial implementation with quantitative spatial modeling and scenario comparison. Although carbon storage estimation is included, the primary focus and central research question is on LULC prediction and simulation. Therefore, it meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
